summary.text: Shannon Isadore is a Democratic state representative from District 33 who has represented the district since September 26, 2024 and is seeking re-election.
The Multnomah and Washington county commissioners appointed her to the seat on September 26, 2024, after Maxine Dexter resigned.

paragraphs.text: Shannon Isadore served in the U.S. Marine Corps.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Clark Atlanta University and a graduate degree in family psychotherapy from Loma Linda University.
Her career experience includes work as CEO of the Oregon Change Clinic.
